technical.summary: Mixed bullish technicals (RSI, three white soldiers, supertrend) offset by weak trend structure (below key MAs, below Ichimoku cloud, low ADX) and negative volume signals (CMF, AO), suggesting caution despite short-term momentum.

fundamental.summary: WHR shows no insider buying conviction, zero institutional 13F activity, no government contract momentum, no lobbying signals, minimal retail interest, and faces elevated volatility risk with earnings 8 days away.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (19/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction (one small purchase 84 days ago, two older sales) and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession, VIX at crisis levels (344.6), strong dollar pressures multinational discretionary spending, CPI event imminent, and earnings binary risk in 8 days—unfavourable environment for WHR.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI 9 bullish, three white soldiers, and supertrend bullish signals combined with extreme fear (19/100) contrarian opportunity and proximity to support (114.26) offer tactical short-term momentum entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar), high earnings risk in 8 days, price below all key moving averages, negative volume signals (CMF, AO), zero fundamental conviction, and unfavourable trend structure (below EMA 21/50, below Ichimoku cloud, low ADX) create unacceptable risk/reward.
